BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.NIBBITS.title: Lunch for One
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.NIBBITS.descr: The nibbit has eaten a hollow through the roots and now sniffs the air beyond it. Lunch is not over. The next course has simply arrived on its own.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SLIMES.title: A Failed Cleanup
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SLIMES.descri: Someone swept the slime into little piles and was left holding a bare broom handle. The piles are now approaching your freshly cleaned boots.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.FLYCONID.desc: The mushroom shelters its neighbor from the rain; the neighbor clears away its scraps. Their arrangement works perfectly. You enter the shade and become something else they can share.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.INKLETS.title: Wet Testimony
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.INKLETS.descr: Three inkblots crowd a blank report, each claiming to have seen the exit. Before you can ask for directions, they begin adding the final strokes to your name.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.OVERGROWTH_CR: The path grows wider and the grass shuts out the sky. The two crawlers have not grown. It is your shadow on the ground that keeps getting smaller.
Three raiders argue over an empty ledger. None will settle for one less coin. Your arrival resolves the question of who will cover the shortfall.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SLITHERING_ST: The vines make room for their companions and close off your path. Their owner seems eager to make a new friend. Letting go has never been part of the plan.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.VINE_SHAMBLER: The house has collapsed, but its vines remember where the door stood. They drag the fallen stones across your path, like a host insisting that you stay the night.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.BYGONE_EFFIGY: The offerings have rotted at the statue's feet. No one remembers who brought them. As you try to pass, the expressionless face turns slightly downward.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.PHROG_PARASIT: Uneven knocking comes from the swollen belly. Only when the host outside falls will the guests within decide to come out and greet you themselves.
Two slugs reach the gathering long after the mourners have gone. The absent guests do not trouble them. Your footsteps, still warm, are far more interesting.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.TOADPOLES.des: Two shapes in the shallows move before the ripples do. You mistake them for young creatures avoiding a stranger, until they close around the place you mean to step.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.CULTISTS.desc: Half the scripture is trapped in stone; the rest has rotted in the water. Two cultists read on with conviction, as if enough volume could bring the missing words back.
The register lists one name. Two voices argue inside the coat by the door. The clerk who checked the headcount has resigned. You will have to verify it yourself.
The ropes have rotted and the harbor is gone, yet the ship never misses its departure. No one stands on deck. The boarding stairs lower for you all the same.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.LIVING_FOG.de: The inspector wrote 'all clear' and never returned. Now the entire corridor is breathing, swallowing the warning signs from its walls one mouthful at a time.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.TWO_TAILED_RA: Three rats wait around a crumb without eating. At your first footstep, word passes into the cracks in the wall. More friends and relations may yet join the table.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SEAPUNK.title: A Shore Dispute
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SEAPUNK.descr: One insists this used to be dry land. The other says everything on shore belongs back in the water. After a long argument, they agree that you are standing in the wrong place.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.PHANTASMAL_GA: Four gardeners tend a flowerless plot. None admits that the season has changed. The first dead leaf you tread on goes onto the account they all keep.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.TERROR_EEL.de: The long shape beneath the water is so still that you almost forget it. Then the fish scatter, and you realize it has already moved somewhere else.
Two workers carry on with their separate tasks. Neither intends to stop. You block the passage, adding one more problem to what should have been a very small job.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.TUNNELER.desc: Every sign above ground points to an exit. Every tunnel below leads to the same nest. A tunneler rises beside your feet, displeased with its uninvited neighbor.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.CHOMPERS.desc: Two sets of iron teeth keep the abandoned workshop neatly chewed. The shift bell broke long ago. Now whichever machine spots a visitor first gets to start work.
Four shells stand neatly by the path, like luggage someone forgot. You are about to pass between them when thin legs unfold from every gap at once.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.OVICOPTER.des: The cradles have no names, only ever tougher shells. The mother overhead keeps adding beds. She seems pleased with the children already chewing through their rails.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SLUMBERING_BE: A sleeping beetle has made a bedroom of the passage. Its two companions remain busy nearby. You soften your steps and realize it is the only resident truly asleep.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.THE_OBSCURA.d: The faint glow cannot light the path, but it stretches your shadow. Something is taking shape in that borrowed light. It does not seem content to remain your shadow.
The stone carrier calls in two colleagues to clear an obstruction. No one at the meeting hears your explanation. In their records, you are the obstruction.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.DECIMILLIPEDE: The head is past the crossing, the tail still around the corner. The rest keeps squeezing by. After a long wait, you realize it never intended to leave room for pedestrians.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.ENTOMANCER.de: The mage whispers to the hive until its humming drowns your breath. He does not care whether you understand. He only wants the message delivered into your bones.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SCROLLS_OF_BI: Three old scrolls sit on a shelf, their margins crowded with borrowing terms. Before you can read the fine print, it opens its mouth to collect an overdue payment.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.TURRET_OPERAT: The gunner keeps the loud commands and leaves incoming danger to the shield in front. The duties are clear. The shield has not yet been invited to comment.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.AXEBOTS.title: A Spare Name
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.AXEBOTS.descr: Every machine carries the same employee number. The disposal form has nowhere to sign. Just as you think the work is finished, a familiar startup sound comes from storage.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.CONSTRUCT_MEN: Two pillars and an iron fist block the passage in what they consider perfect symmetry. You point out a small discrepancy. They begin adjusting the surplus component: you.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.FABRICATOR.de: Only the fabricator remains in the workshop. It refuses to admit a staffing shortage. As you approach, it assembles faster, leaving its new colleagues to welcome you.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.THE_LOST_AND_: One remembers being left behind. The other has forgotten who left it. They have waited here a long time. Your arrival gives them someone to blame for the delay.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.OWL_MAGISTRAT: The verdict is on the desk before you speak. The magistrate needs only a name for the blank. You try to object, and it notes with satisfaction: 'refuses to confess.'
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.FROG_KNIGHT.d: No one remembers who knighted it. It guards the road with undiminished resolve. Before the water dries on its armor, it challenges the next passerby.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.KNIGHTS.title: Echoes of an Oath
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.KNIGHTS.descr: Three knights keep three vows. Some are already dead; some refuse to admit it. They agree on one duty: the stranger before them must not pass.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SOUL_NEXUS.de: Every unfinished sentence crowds into this place, refusing to let another speak. You hear your name called, but cannot find a face that might answer you.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.CEREMONIAL_BE: The last officiant is gone, but the beast remembers every step. With no new prayer to guide it, the ritual accepts the intruder as its offering.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.VANTOM.title: A Shape Kept in Ink
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.VANTOM.descri: The shadow on the wall once belonged to something alive. Only the ink remembers its shape. You raise a light, and the outline grows stranger than it was in darkness.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.THE_KIN.title: A Family Observance
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.THE_KIN.descr: Two followers make room for their priest, as if awaiting a late relative. Their welcoming dance draws closer. The place they have saved for you is on the altar.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.WATERFALL_GIA: Water roars inside it, with no riverhead to be found. The giant rises, and the flood trapped in the ruins finally finds a direction: toward you.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.SOUL_FYSH.des: Familiar faces rise beneath the water and gather into an unfamiliar fish. It beckons gently, as though sinking were no kind of farewell.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.LAGAVULIN_MAT: At the Door of an Old Dream
The matriarch keeps her long sleep for the nest and her waking moments for intruders. You cannot tell which old dream you stepped on. Her claws are already reaching past the door.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.THE_INSATIABL: The earth swallows rain, leaves and lost travelers, yet the hollow below remains empty. Now the hollow opens its own mouth, ready to swallow the road as well.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.KNOWLEDGE_DEM: It will answer every question you bring, and has prepared others you have not thought to ask. The pages keep turning. You are forgetting why you came here at all.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.KAISER_CRAB.d: This ruler needs no reply from its subjects. Claw and rocket explain every command. You stand at its declared border, until the turning launcher reveals that the border is still expanding.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.AEONGLASS.des: The final grain refuses to fall. Those waiting beneath it have worn many faces. Watching the narrowing light, you can no longer tell whether you are passing time or being counted by it.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.QUEEN.title: The Last Subject
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STAGE.QUEEN.descrip: The queen keeps the fire for the amalgam beside her and silence for her empty court. At last she notices you in the doorway, and raises a hand to welcome her final subject.
The recorder keeps assigning new subject numbers and refuses to write 'failure.' Behind the cage door, something raises its head again. This time your name appears on the observation list.
